items.title: native — a captured value RETURNED from a closure is MOVED out of an `Fn` closure (rustc E0507): a closure body's tail and a `match` leg are not treated as consuming positions, so the value is moved where it should be copied; blocks `KeyedSource::or` natively (`reactive_channels`' KEYED_MIRROR_IS_A_SOURCE)
items.discussion: native-43 (2026-09-28); repro in its report (`\|\| initial` and `\|value\| match value { Some(let p) => p, None => initial }` — JS prints 6 then 2, native fails E0507 twice); F46 (the last-use pass is the seam)
items.body: Fix in the last-use pass / the emitter: a closure's tail (and each match leg in tail position) is a consuming position of a CAPTURED value only if the closure is `FnOnce`; for `Fn` it copies. Pin the repro as a native differential case. Sizing S; native, Order 44.

items.title: a FALSE 'a view cannot escape its scope': `mut edits: List<\|&mut List<i32>\| void> = []; edits.push(\|&mut list\| list.push(7));` is refused on both backends although the closure captures NOTHING — the `&mut` is its PARAMETER, which is the form the message itself recommends
items.discussion: native-43 (2026-09-28, met while building F44); B364 (the closure-record-over-`&mut self` refusal is the same check reading a parameter as a capture)
items.body: The escape check must distinguish a `&mut` parameter of the closure from a `&mut` capture. Pin red-first on both backends. Sizing S; solver, Order 44.
